title: Good Integers: (T,k)-Subclasses and Applications to Galois Duality in Coding Theory
summary: The notion of good integers, namely the divisors of the sequence $(a^s+b^s)_{s\ge 1}$ for nonzero coprime integers $a$ and $b$, together with their subfamilies such as oddly-good and evenly-good integers, has become an important arithmetic tool in the study of Euclidean and Hermitian dualities for abelian and cyclic codes. Building on this perspective, this paper introduces and studies another interesting subclass of good integers arising from the sequence $\bigl(a^{ks+T}+b^{ks+T}\bigr)_{s\ge 1}$ for some integers $0\leq T<k$, whose divisors are called $(T,k)$-{\em good integers with respect…
